name: Raptor Horns
summary: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix seeks intact raptor horns for a scheme of his own. He believes the Barrens raptors owe their cunning to their horns, and pays travelers to hunt Sunscale Scytheclaws.

sections.title: Goblin Entrepreneurship
sections.body: Mebok Mizzyrix chases fortune in Ratchet, where goblins are forever trying one scheme after another. He has watched the Barrens raptors act with more craft and coordination than beasts elsewhere. So Mebok decided their intelligence must lie in their horns. He seeks no formal inquiry. He means to turn the idea to profit.

sections.title: The Sunscale Scytheclaws
sections.body: Mebok wants undamaged horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, among the Barrens' deadliest predators. They prowl the southern stretches of the Barrens and the northern borders near Ashenvale. These raptors hunt in packs and defend their territory fiercely. Bringing one down and taking its horns intact calls for skill in battle.

sections.title: A Recipe for Riches
sections.body: Mebok Mizzyrix plans to grind the intact horns into fine powder, then brew it into drinks. He calls them “smart drinks” and hopes patrons will buy wit in a bottle. Mebok is convinced the scheme will make him wealthy overnight.

faq.q: Why does Mebok Mizzyrix want raptor horns?
faq.answer: Mebok believes the cunning of Barrens raptors lies in their horns. He plans to grind the horns into powder, brew “smart drinks,” and sell them for profit.
Sunscale Scytheclaws roam the southern Barrens and the northern stretches near the Ashenvale border.

faq.q: Are raptor horns actually magical or mind-enhancing?
faq.answer: Mebok's claim that raptor horns hold their wit is goblin pseudoscience driven by profit. The Barrens raptors are cunning, but nothing here shows their horns are magical or mind-enhancing.
Mebok Mizzyrix is an ambitious goblin merchant in Ratchet, the port town. He pursues dubious schemes and concoctions to make a fortune from travelers passing through.

faq.q: What happens after collecting the horns?
faq.answer: Mebok plans to grind the intact horns into powder and brew them into drinks he calls “smart drinks.”

faq.q: Can Alliance players help Mebok with this task?
faq.answer: Yes. Ratchet is an open port managed by the Steamwheedle Cartel. Mebok is a neutral goblin who does business with both the Horde and the Alliance.

angles.text: As a hunter familiar with Kalimdor's raptor packs, you know how cunning and deadly they can be. Mebok's belief that their wit can be bottled is goblin quackery.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can find a neutral foothold in the Horde-dominated Barrens at Ratchet. Odd jobs like Mebok's offer a chance to earn coin and Steamwheedle favor.
